title: CTrees global aboveground biomass, 100 m annual (Icechunk)
description:
ctrees.org global annual aboveground biomass (AGB) at 100 m, 2000-2025, published as a bare Icechunk 2.x repository (a `repo` config object plus `chunks/`, `manifests/`, `snapshots/` prefixes -- confirmed by a 200 on the `repo` object; there is no `zarr.json`/`.zattrs` at this path because Icechunk stores its own metadata inside the repo, not as plain Zarr files). CORS confirmed (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` on the S3 bucket). Per-array shapes/chunks/dtype were not independently inspected (that needs the Icechunk manifest format, not a plain HTTP GET), so none are declared here. bbox is estimated (global biomass coverage, excluding high latitudes where AGB is not mapped).

License unknown; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: draws if the Icechunk client in this browser can open a bare-repo-object 2.x layout; otherwise refused with a notice.

time.description: Annual, 2000-2025 (26 years); not independently confirmed from the manifest.
